feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED. All five declared propositions have exactly one predicate each, names match the identifiers, and each takes exactly `env`. `blocker_moved` reads only the current grid and correctly checks that the cell in front of the door on the start side (left of the door in the shared wall, since the box room is the right room) holds no ball: a carried ball is off-grid so it counts as moved, and dropping the ball back there flips the predicate false again. `door_open` reads the door's `is_open` from the current observation only. `has_door_key` requires a carried key whose color matches the scanned door's color, with the carrying and cell guards in place. `key_lost` is a proper event: it requires a truthy previous valuation with `has_door_key` true, negates the current has_door_key and door_open conditions inline (avoiding sibling calls), stays false on the first step because the previous valuation is empty or all-false, and never holds with door open or key carried, matching the documented event semantics. `target_picked_up` matches the mission format 'pick up the <color> box' against the carried box color without assuming a fixed color. Only allowed builtins (any, bool, str, range) are used, bodies are single-expression returns with no assignments or control flow, all scans guard None cells and `env.carrying` before attribute reads, there is no mutation of `env` or `env.episode_memory`, no `.get` on the previous valuation, and no undocumented API attributes, RM-state, reward, or description dependence.
